subject: [PATCH v8 27/30] mm: don't PTE-batch a swap-in over a hardware-poisoned subpage

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch prevents the PTE-batching mechanism from mapping a swap-in over a hardware-poisoned subpage, which could lead to undetected faults. The problem arises because the batching path doesn't check for poisoned subpages individually, allowing a faulting page to be mapped even if one of its subpages is poisoned. To fix this, the patch adds a check to ensure that each subpage is tested separately before mapping the folio, using the `folio_has_hwpoisoned_subpage` function to detect poisoned subpages.
